title: manettia lygistum var. alba
intro: Manettia lygistum var. alba, commonly known as White Jamaica Dogwood, is a plant species in the Rubiaceae family, native to the tropical regions of the Americas. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Manettia lygistum var. alba include its ability to reduce inflammation, lower fever, and alleviate symptoms of digestive disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
